closure_scope: historical and research validation only; no production promotion

geometry.note: Published academic morphometry varies by study extent and method; repository DEM geometry remains the independent spatial unit for validation.

idesep_transect.interpretation: No spatial gradient resolved across the three sampled points at IDESEP product resolution.

limitations: IMERG 0.1 degree samples only a small number of grid cells over the catchment.
No direct sub-hourly gauge series for the 2017 and 2023 impact events is available in the repository.

historical_cases.official_outcome_context: INDECI/SINPAD/COEP evidence reproduced in 2023 academic thesis records activation at approximately 21:30 local time with documented urban damage.

sources.citation: Ahumada Zavala, D. C.; Espino Aparcana, L. C. (2023). Análisis del comportamiento hidráulico de las estructuras de retención de sólidos en la cabecera de la cuenca de la quebrada San Idelfonso. UPAO.

sources.citation: Rebaza Reyes, A. S. (2023). Gestión de riesgo y el impacto por activación de quebrada San Idelfonso en el contexto urbano Trujillo – 2023. Universidad César Vallejo.

hydrologic_hydraulic_context.current_infrastructure_note: Repository context reports 2026 retention, capture and diversion works as operational, but detailed as-built hydraulic capacity and overflow behaviour are not independently validated here.

historical_separation.interpretation: Useful discriminant evidence for research replay; three cases are insufficient to estimate operational sensitivity, false-alarm rate or seasonal robustness.

closure_decision.reason: Geometry, rainfall context, positive historical outcomes, one negative control, debris-flow mechanism and urban impact chain are sufficiently documented for a bounded research validation case. Remaining uncertainty is explicitly carried rather than fabricated.
does_not_authorize: assumption that historical rainfall-impact relationships remain unchanged under 2026 infrastructure
future_evidence_that_can_improve_confide: as-built hydraulic capacity and overflow behaviour of current infrastructure
